title: AI Cannot Review What Humans Catch: A First Look at the Reviews of Agent Instruction Files
abstract: arXiv:2611.18582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents increasingly shape software, and instruction files steer them. Files such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, and SKILL.md act as executable policy: prose that a machine reads and acts on. Unlike ordinary documentation, a single edit to one of these files can silently redirect how an agent behaves across an entire repository. Natural-language rules have no per-change oracle, so they slip past the compilers, type-checkers, and test suites that guard code. Review is therefore the only quality gate, but no prior work has studied how that review happens. We analyzed 2,870 instruction-file pull requests across 2,246 repositories. The gate is largely broken: over 70% of instruction-file changes receive no substantive review. When an AI reviewer substitutes for a human, it is structurally blind to the concerns that most need human judgment. It catches surface structure but misses factual errors, necessity questions, and staleness prob

translated_title: AI 无法审查出人类才能发现的问题：智能体指令文件代码评审的首次研究
translated_abstract: 智能体日益塑造着软件，而指令文件则在引导它们。诸如 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules 和 SKILL.md 之类的文件扮演着“可执行策略”的角色：它们是机器读取并据以行动的文本。与普通文档不同，对这类文件的一次修改就可能悄无声息地改变智能体在整个代码仓库中的行为方式。自然语言规则没有针对每次变更的验证标准，因此它们能绕过守护代码的编译器、类型检查器和测试套件。因此，评审成为唯一的质量关卡，但此前尚无研究考察这种评审是如何进行的。我们分析了来自 2,246 个代码仓库的 2,870 个指令文件拉取请求。这道关卡在很大程度上已经失效：超过 70% 的指令文件变更没有得到实质性评审。当 AI 评审者替代人类评审者时，它对最需要人类判断的问题是结构性失明的：它能发现表面结构问题，却会遗漏事实错误、必要性问题以及内容过时问题。
tldr: 该论文首次研究了智能体指令文件的评审现状，通过分析 2,246 个仓库中的 2,870 个拉取请求发现，超过 70% 的指令文件变更缺乏实质性评审，而 AI 评审者虽能发现表面结构问题，却对事实错误、必要性与内容过时等最需要人类判断的问题是结构性失明的。
en_tdlr: In the first study of agent instruction file reviews, analyzing 2,870 pull requests across 2,246 repositories, the authors show that over 70% of instruction-file changes receive no substantive review, and AI reviewers are structurally blind to factual errors, necessity, and staleness—concerns that most require human judgment.
